label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: The rebuilt temple looked small next to Solomon's — God promised its glory would be greater.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the _____ is not your's, but God's.
verse: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not your's, but God's.
note: A vast army is coming; the prophet Jahaziel tells King Jehoshaphat the battle isn't yours, but God's.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one _____ in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verse: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
note: Matthew applies Isaiah's 'voice of one crying in the wilderness' to John the Baptist, the road crew for the coming King.

label: Deep Water
prompt: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without _____ before him in love:
verse: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
note: Chosen before the foundation of the world — God's plan for his people predates the planet.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He _____ not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verse: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
note: Abraham, about a hundred years old, 'staggered not at the promise' — no wobble, just stronger faith.
